title: Google Baked Gemini Into a Chip: Frozen v2 Explained
description:
Google just baked Gemini directly into their AI chips 🔥 The chip, called Frozen v2, has Gemini's architecture built into the silicon, and its 6-10x more efficient than todays TPUs. New weights load separately so it wont go obsolete every release. Cheaper queries means Google can undercut OpenAI and Anthropic on price ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
